# Protect, Optimize, and Scale Your Infrastructure for AI

Confidently meet the demands of AI with solutions that secure and deliver your mission-critical
applications and networks

[ Explore Solutions ][137]

### Purpose-built Solutions

## Build secure, high‑performance AI‑ready infrastructure

A10 keeps your applications, networks, cloud services, and data centers running fast, secure,
and reliable.

Whether you’re an enterprise or a service provider, get the protection, performance, and centralized
management you need to deliver consistent connectivity without complexity.

[Purpose-built Solutions][Purpose-built Solutions]

### Security Solutions

#### Protect your business from emerging security threats

With AI changing how applications connect and communicate, traffic patterns are becoming
increasingly unpredictable and introducing risks like DDoS attacks, API abuse, inference
manipulation, and shadow AI.

A10 Networks delivers comprehensive protection across network and application layers and APIs,
defending against DDoS attacks, bots, infiltration, exfiltration, prompt injection, and more.

[ Protect Your Apps & Networks ][138]
[Security Solutions][Security Solutions]

### Infrastructure Solutions

#### Ensure ultra-low latency performance for mission-critical AI applications

Modern applications and AI workloads must operate flawlessly across on-prem, cloud, and edge
environments.

A10 Networks provides industry-leading performance, low latency and GPU-aware load balancing. Built
on a unified architecture with flexible licensing, A10 solutions ensure your mission-critical apps
are fast, secure, and available.

[ Optimize & Scale Your Infrastructure ][139]
[Infrastructure Solutions][Infrastructure Solutions]

### Centralized Management & Automation Solutions

#### Simplify operations across complex environments

Managing infrastructure across multiple clouds is becoming increasingly complex, especially for
AI‑enabled apps that demand precise capacity planning and prompt scaling.

### Secure identities.
### Shut out attackers.

Seamlessly secure identities throughout the cycle of accessing any resource across any
infrastructure, including hybrid, SaaS and multi-cloud. The CyberArk identity security platform is
the first line of defense against malicious actors and unauthorized access to protect what matters
most.

[Request a Demo][119]


#### Seamless & secure access for all identities

By combining secure SSO, Adaptive MFA, Lifecycle Management, Directory Services and User Behavior
Analytics, we help you streamline operations and give users simple and secure access to
resources—on-premises, cloud, hybrid—from any location, using any device.


#### Intelligent privilege controls

Apply world-class intelligent privilege controls across the IT estate, as well as differentiated
controls to secure the unique needs of workforce users, third-party vendors, endpoints and machine
identities as they access sensitive data.


#### Flexible identity automation & orchestration

Streamline HR processes, ensure users have the right access to the right resources, enable
compliance with industry or government regulations, and improve efficiencies across the board with
orchestration and lifecycle management, permissions and entitlements, and directory and federation
services.

### Identity Security Defined

Centered on intelligent privilege controls, identity security seamlessly secures access for all
identities and flexibly automates the identity lifecycle with continuous threat detection and
prevention — all with a unified approach.

[Explore the Platform][120]

_crawl.linkedin_about: Secure networks start here.™ Netgate is focused on delivering secure high-performance network connectivity for everyone. Netgate believes in enhancing network connectivity that maintains both security and privacy. We also believe everyone should be able to afford it. Netgate directly supports and contributes to open source networking, secure IoT and firewall initiatives while also developing new high throughput secure networking technologies for the cloud and the IDIoT (Inherently Dangerous Internet of Things). We develop solutions that leverage our decades of experience in networking, security, open source, embedded, software and hardware engineering. We are breaking down the cost barriers to bring connectivity with security and privacy to everyone. Our security applications and solutions, such as open source pfSense®, TNSR® and Netgate systems provide real world protection for networks of all sizes. You can be confident your networks are secure. Netgate is: • The host of the pfSense® open source firewall project. Netgate contributes leadership, engineering, test, and infrastructure assets to the project. pfSense has more than 1 million active installs, supporting every size network from the home to small governments on all seven continents (yes, even Antarctica.) • The developer of TNSR. Advanced open source-based Firewall, Router, and VPN platform with breakthrough enterprise-class performance, management, and service expansion flexibility. • The source for deep domain expertise in Unix, networking, computer security, embedded software development and system development. Our “open source” roots reach back to the 1980s, and we are well known within the BSD networking and security communities. • The developer of a popular family of low-power, high-throughput networking platforms from micro-sized form factor to small rack-mount systems.
_crawl.key_brands_represented: pfSense Plus; TNSR

organizations that are moving toward cloud-based applications as a service, and that have a

security management.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response. Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats. Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. More information is available at www.sophos.com.
_crawl.key_brands_represented: Next-gen firewall (NGFW); Sophos Fusion; Sophos Central; Endpoint protection; EDR - Endpoint detection and response; ITDR - Identity threat detection and response; XDR - Extended detection and response; Next-Gen SIEM; Cloud workload protection; Email and phishing protection

With a global partner ecosystem, Sophos provides organizations the flexibility to enhance their security posture and effectively combat evolving cyber threats.

This breakthrough patented solution represents a leap forward in the evolution of cybersecurity,

### **A Better Approach to Cyber-Attack Detection, Response, and Containment**

][30]
[[Cyber Security Expert]][31]

We took a different path when developing our threat detection and response solutions. Unlike other
providers, we monitor all the network traffic and generate analytics to enable complete
enterprise-wide visibility.

This helps our solutions assist in the identification and disruption of attacks in two important
ways: improve the performance of your existing security stack or deploy automated and full AI-driven
SOC capabilities within a single platform. Customers in a range of industries rely on our solutions
to improve their security posture—no matter their environment.

[Learn More][32]
[

### **AI-SOC Run From the Cloud or On-Premise – The Choice is Yours**

][33]

Our ARIA CloudADR solution is a fully AI-automated, cloud-based virtual SOC that provides an
attractive entry point for companies that need to protect both on-premises and public cloud
infrastructure for pennies on the dollar compared to running a physical SOC. Any ARIA CloudADR can
be upgraded to a full ARIA ADR solution with the deployment of a network-attached platform capable
of detecting and stopping all types of network-borne threats and attacks involving the premises

Both solutions include the equivalent functionality of seven different security tools, all of which
are replaced by more advanced ML-based threat detection models driven by AI. As a result, only
confirmed threats and/or cyber-attacks are presented and stopped in minutes as they become
active—all without human involvement.

# Inclusive cyber security

We work with a network of cyber security experts to help organisations of all sizes improve and
demonstrate their cyber security.

Fairness and inclusion are central to our business and we bring these values to everything we do.

## What we do

**IASME is a cyber security certification company based in the Malvern Hills, with an office in
Belfast and one in Dalgety Bay, near Edinburgh. **

We work with a network of more than 900 cyber security experts to help organisations of all sizes to
improve and demonstrate their cyber security. 

We also certify connected devices and commercial maritime vessels of all sizes from across the
world.

Additionally, via the Civil Aviation Authority’s ASSURE scheme, we provide the aviation industry
with an audit mechanism to review and manage their cyber security risks.

[About Us][34]

## Building Inclusion

**In the fast-changing world of cyber security, IASME strives to make a difference.**

Our core values revolve around Fairness and Inclusion which shape everything we do. We’re committed
to making the cyber security landscape more equitable and accessible.

[Accessible Certification]
[Inclusive Opportunities]
[Diverse Workforce]

**Accessible Certification**

**Inclusive Opportunities**

**Diverse Workforce**

We’ve designed our cyber security certification schemes to be accessible and affordable for even the
smallest organisation.

Our schemes aim to make cyber security opportunities available to organisations of all sizes across
the UK and beyond.

We actively work towards ensuring that individuals from all backgrounds and neurotypes can pursue a
career in cyber security.

**Accessible Certification**

**Inclusive Opportunities**

**Diverse Workforce**

## IASME Community

IASME Community is the community interest and social enterprise arm of IASME. It was previously
called UK Cyber Security Forum (UKCSF). 

Our projects aim to:
* facilitate a more diverse community in the cyber security industry
* develop cyber security projects that help communities

[][35]
[Find out more][36]

## Our Schemes

IASME is the sole delivery partner for the National Cyber Security Centre’s (NCSC) [Cyber Essentials
][37] scheme and [Cyber Advisor][38] scheme.

We are also one of two Delivery Partners for the NCSC Industry Assurance schemes, [Cyber Incident
Exercising][39] and [Cyber Incident Response Standard Level][40]. In this role, we are responsible
for the assessment and onboarding process to ensure that each provider meets the NCSC’s rigorous
security and quality standards for cyber incident exercising and response.

Through our nation-wide network of assured Certification Bodies, IASME delivers the [Defence Cyber
Certification (DCC)][41] scheme, an organisation-wide cyber security certification framework for UK
defence suppliers.
IASME runs a further five independent cyber security certification schemes for organisations, marine
vessels, and IoT devices, and through these schemes, have made a considerable impact to the security
of the UK.

## National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) Schemes

[Cyber Essentials][42] is the UK Government approved certification scheme. The scheme is centred
around five core controls that if implemented correctly, will protect any organisation from the
majority of the most common cyber attacks.

[Find out more][43]

The [Cyber Advisor][44] scheme provides small and medium sized organisations with reliable and cost
effective cyber security advice and practical support.

[Find out more][45]

[Cyber Incident Response (CIR) Standard Level][46] is an industry assurance scheme that was created
to help organisations that have been a victim of a cyber attack.

[Find out more][47]

The [Cyber Incident Exercising (CIE)][48] scheme was created to assist organisations in finding an
assured provider to help them test their cyber incident response plans and make improvements before
a cyber attack occurs.

[Find out more][49]

security. The scheme aligns with UK legislation and all of the 13 provisions in the **ETSI EN 303
645 standard**, extending beyond just the top three required for UK law.

vessels and is accessible to operators and vessels of all sizes from across the world.

mechanism to review and manage the cyber security risks within the sector via a network of Cyber

**Oracle**.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Secure networks start here.™ Netgate is focused on delivering secure high-performance network connectivity for everyone. Netgate believes in enhancing network connectivity that maintains both security and privacy. We also believe everyone should be able to afford it. Netgate directly supports and contributes to open source networking, secure IoT and firewall initiatives while also developing new high throughput secure networking technologies for the cloud and the IDIoT (Inherently Dangerous Internet of Things). We develop solutions that leverage our decades of experience in networking, security, open source, embedded, software and hardware engineering. We are breaking down the cost barriers to bring connectivity with security and privacy to everyone. Our security applications and solutions, such as open source pfSense®, TNSR® and Netgate systems provide real world protection for networks of all sizes. You can be confident your networks are secure. Netgate is: • The host of the pfSense® open source firewall project. Netgate contributes leadership, engineering, test, and infrastructure assets to the project. pfSense has more than 1 million active installs, supporting every size network from the home to small governments on all seven continents (yes, even Antarctica.) • The developer of TNSR. Advanced open source-based Firewall, Router, and VPN platform with breakthrough enterprise-class performance, management, and service expansion flexibility. • The source for deep domain expertise in Unix, networking, computer security, embedded software development and system development. Our “open source” roots reach back to the 1980s, and we are well known within the BSD networking and security communities. • The developer of a popular family of low-power, high-throughput networking platforms from micro-sized form factor to small rack-mount systems.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

_crawl.linkedin_about: The Sonatype journey started 15 years ago, just as the concept of “open source” software development was gaining steam. From our humble beginning as core contributors to Apache Maven, to supporting the world’s largest repository of open source components (Central), to distributing the world's most popular repository manager (Sonatype Nexus Repository), we’ve played a meaningful role in helping the world embrace the power of open innovation. Over time, we witnessed the staggering volume and variety of open source libraries that began flowing into every development environment in the world. We understood that when open source components are properly managed, they provide a tremendous energy for accelerating innovation. Conversely, when unmanaged, open source "gone wild"​ can lead directly to security vulnerabilities, licensing risks, enormous rework, and waste. Our vision today is simple. We are laser focused on helping organizations continuously harness all of the good that open source has to offer, without any of the risk. In order to do this, we have invested in knowing more about the quality of open source than anyone else in the world. This investment takes the form of machine learning, artificial intelligence, and human expertise, which in aggregate produces highly curated intelligence that is infused into every Sonatype product. Organizations equipped with Sonatype products make better decisions, innovate faster at scale, and rest comfortably knowing that their applications always consist of the highest quality open source components.

We proactively monitor, detect, and resolve network issues before they disrupt your business —
helping IT teams reduce operational burden and maintain confidence at scale.
* Faster incident detection and escalation.

in the face of dynamic innovation. With over 15 years of experience in enterprise IT operations, we
are the trusted partner for mission-critical 24/7 network operations.

devices connected to the remote site with simplicity and efficiency. With a single click you can
securely connect to lighting systems, control systems, network switches, IP cameras, network video
recorders, network attached storage, printers and anything else that supports web access (HTTP,
HTTPS). No public IP address or additional firewall configuration is required.

delivered via Telegram messenger. We also actively monitor security-related events and notify you

monitoring and management system. Each team member can have their own individual login, enabling

For even greater organization, take advantage of our powerful Custom Labels feature. This allows you
to create groups of sites or nodes to streamline your monitoring process. By selecting specific
labels, you can easily view and manage the sites or nodes that are most relevant to your needs.

you to instantly jump to the site of interest.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

_crawl.linkedin_about: We are Newark, part of Farnell Global, the fast and reliable distributor of products and technology for electronic and industrial system design, maintenance, and repair. From research and design through prototype to production, we are here to help you access the products and services you need 24/7. With more than 80 years of experience, 48 localized websites, and a dedicated team of over 3,300 employees, we provide every component you need to build the technology of tomorrow. Farnell Global trades as Newark in the Americas, Farnell in Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Japan, and element14 across Asia Pacific. It also sells direct to consumers through its CPC business in the UK. We have been part of the established global technology distributor, Avnet, since 2016. Today, this relationship allows us to support our customers at every stage of the product life cycle, offering a truly unique distribution model, as well as expertise in end-to-end delivery and product design. For more information, visit: https://bit.ly/44I8osr Stay up-to-date with us across: Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/newarkelectronics Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/Newark_Avnet Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/newark_electronics Community: www.community.element14.com
_crawl.key_brands_represented: electronics & Technology!; products; technology for electronic; industrial system design; maintenance

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Newark, part of Farnell Global and a subsidiary of Avnet, is a leading distributor of products and technology for electronic and industrial system design, maintenance, and repair. With over 80 years of experience and a dedicated team of more than 3,300 employees, Newark provides comprehensive support throughout the product life cycle, offering a wide range of components and services to customers across the Americas and beyond. The company is committed to delivering fast and reliable solutions, ensuring access to essential products 24/7.

# Protect, Optimize, and Scale Your Infrastructure for AI

Confidently meet the demands of AI with solutions that secure and deliver your mission-critical
applications and networks

[ Explore Solutions ][137]

### Purpose-built Solutions

## Build secure, high‑performance AI‑ready infrastructure

A10 keeps your applications, networks, cloud services, and data centers running fast, secure,
and reliable.

Whether you’re an enterprise or a service provider, get the protection, performance, and centralized
management you need to deliver consistent connectivity without complexity.

[Purpose-built Solutions][Purpose-built Solutions]

### Security Solutions

#### Protect your business from emerging security threats

With AI changing how applications connect and communicate, traffic patterns are becoming
increasingly unpredictable and introducing risks like DDoS attacks, API abuse, inference
manipulation, and shadow AI.

A10 Networks delivers comprehensive protection across network and application layers and APIs,
defending against DDoS attacks, bots, infiltration, exfiltration, prompt injection, and more.

[ Protect Your Apps & Networks ][138]
[Security Solutions][Security Solutions]

### Infrastructure Solutions

#### Ensure ultra-low latency performance for mission-critical AI applications

Modern applications and AI workloads must operate flawlessly across on-prem, cloud, and edge
environments.

A10 Networks provides industry-leading performance, low latency and GPU-aware load balancing. Built
on a unified architecture with flexible licensing, A10 solutions ensure your mission-critical apps
are fast, secure, and available.

[ Optimize & Scale Your Infrastructure ][139]
[Infrastructure Solutions][Infrastructure Solutions]

Managing infrastructure across multiple clouds is becoming increasingly complex, especially for
AI‑enabled apps that demand precise capacity planning and prompt scaling.

**What is Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)**

Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) is a term coined by Gartner that combines security and network
functions into a unified cloud-based service, simplifying the management of complex networks while
providing protection against a wide range of cyber threats. SASE is particularly relevant for
organizations that are moving toward cloud-based applications as a service, and that have a
distributed workforce or branch offices. It offers a more agile and secure approach to network and
security management.

[Learn more][80]

## Explore the Open Systems Platform

Enable work-from-anywhere and empower cloud adoption and scale. Open Systems SASE Experience is a
native, managed SASE offering that ensures high availability, secure access with agility,
resilience, and security to maximize IT investments and free teams to focus on driving business
success.

**Proactive Service Experience**

Our Mission Control team provides follow-the-sun management and support from Level-3 engineers to
maximize your performance, productivity, and security.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

# BIBEK JYOTI ROY

Cybersecurity Expert & Serial Entrepreneur

On a mission to build a secure digital world, empowering individuals and businesses against the
ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats.

## / ABOUT ME

Bibek Jyoti Roy is an Indian cybersecurity expert and entrepreneur. He has made significant
contributions in the fields of programming, bug bounty, penetration testing, and Open Source
Intelligence (OSINT). He has helped many companies, such as IND Money and Phind, identify security
vulnerabilities in their systems. In 2021, he founded Psylinks Security, a company dedicated to
providing advanced cybersecurity solutions, and has since expanded into education, blockchain, open
research, and health & wellness sectors with multiple ventures aimed at creating positive societal
impact.

### Personal

Born: 23 September 2002 (age 22)

Location: Guwahati, Assam, India

Parents: Bijan Roy & Juthika Roy

### Education

Arya Vidyapeeth College

Girijananda Choudhury Institute of Management and Technology, Guwahati

### Organizations Founded

Psylinks Security (2021)

Blockvizion (2023)

Tutoring Point (2024)

Codesity (2025)

Cafel (2025)

### Skills & Expertise

Programming Bug Hunting Penetration Testing OSINT

### Books Written

Play, Click and Learn (2024)

[ Buy on Amazon → ][12]

### / CONNECT

[LinkedIn][13] [Twitter][14] [Mastodon][15] [Pinterest][16] [Instagram][17] [Threads][18]
[Facebook][19]

## / VENTURES

### Psylinks Security

Founded: 2021

An enterprise tech company dedicated to protecting businesses and individuals from cyber threats
through advanced threat detection, data protection, and customized security strategies.

### Blockvizion

Founded: 2023

A forward-thinking venture exploring the applications of blockchain technology to enhance data
security, transparency, and create decentralized solutions for modern digital challenges.

### Tutoring Point

Founded: 2024

An education service startup dedicated to providing high-quality, personalized learning experiences.
Tutoring Point connects students with dedicated educators for tailored home tutoring and academic
support.

### Codesity

Founded: 2025

An independent open research company operating as a fully private, not-for-profit entity. Conducts
rigorous research and development across technology, medicine, food science, and education systems.
All findings and innovations are made freely accessible to society, advancing human knowledge and
wellbeing without commercial constraints or external influence.

### Cafel

Founded: 2025

Guwahati's premier healthy dining destination in Jyotikuchi, offering scientifically-designed meals
that heal and nourish. Features traditional Indian and authentic Assamese cuisine made with 100%
organic, farm-fresh ingredients—no preservatives, chemicals, or refined oils. Every dish is cooked
fresh to order for genuine well-being.

## / VISION

"My vision extends beyond simply reacting to threats. I believe in proactive, intelligent security
that anticipates and neutralizes risks before they can cause harm. We are moving towards a future
where cybersecurity is not a barrier, but an enabler of innovation and trust."

"Through my ventures, we are committed to continuous research and development, staying ahead of the
curve and building a resilient digital infrastructure for the next generation of technology. From
securing digital assets to advancing open scientific research and nourishing physical health, each
venture serves a purpose in creating a better, more equitable tomorrow where knowledge and wellbeing
are accessible to all."

## / CONTACT US

We welcome your feedback, inquiries, and comments. Please feel free to reach out.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized
Resellers][49] page for a distributor in your region.

CSSI

A leader in engineered asset protection using composite material technology.

# Advanced Fire, Ballistic & Impact Protection SolutionsEngineered Ceramic Composite Panels Designed
# to Protect Critical Assets

CSSI delivers engineered protection solutions backed by proven research and unmatched material
performance. We combine proven technical expertise with advanced ceramic composites that offer
exceptional [fire][13] and [ballistic resistance][14], structural integrity, and long-term
durability, even in the most demanding environments.

[Our clients][15] include architectural and engineering firms, utility contractors, public and
private utilities, defense contractors, data management companies, and government agencies. We work
closely with our customers to develop tailored composite solutions to protect their critical,
sensitive, and valuable assets.

## Why Choose CSSI?

### Customizable Sizes and Designs
* Modular lightweight panels (320 lb.) for easy handling and installation.
* A standard wall (35 feet L x 30 feet H) can be installed in one day.
* Short manufacturing time, 4–6 weeks, and 3–4 months for large orders.
* Permanent or deployable wall systems available.
* Designed and manufactured in the USA.

### Reduction in Time, Labor and Costs
* Material costs are typically in line with precast concrete options.
* Panels are installed quickly, saving time and reducing labor costs.
* Freight and shipping costs are lower than those for concrete wall systems.

### Environmental Responsible Panels
* Panels are manufactured using sustainable technology.
* Manufacturing and shipping related CO₂ emissions are reduced when compared to concrete wall
  systems.

## Ceramic Composite Panel Benefits
* Firewall panels are formed to include air pockets for superior thermal insulation and fire
  resistance.
* Internal air pockets of ballistic panels are filled with sand or pea gravel to absorb and
  dissipate energy from gunshots and ballistic projectiles.
* Steel columns, casings, and nuts are protected using composite materials.
* Designed to minimize load-bearing impact at the base of the wall.
* Panels exceed government and private industry tests for strength and impact.
* No maintenance needed.
* Earthquake proof.
* Walls can be installed in extreme cold climates and withstand severe weather and harsh
  environmental conditions.

## Protecting Critical Infrastructure from the Ground Up

Let’s get started on a composite wall solution for you today.

integrate artificial intelligence into military cyber operations at AI Defense Forum, the annual
defense and intelligence conference hosted by C3 AI, on Sept. 10, 2024. The AI roadmap aims to
improve analytic capabilities, scale operations, and enhance adversary disruption.

# EVORIM Excellent software

###### We develop software. Successfully.

###### Our software protects you, your privacy and your data.

###### Use our software and be amazed.

## Advanced Backup

Reliable and fast data backup

Advanced Backup is backup software that lets you professionally back up your important files and
drives. The program offers a variety of functions and settings. Scheduled or manual backups to all
common media with optional compression and encryption of your data.

[ Advanced Backup ][11]

## Free Firewall

Identify threats.
Protect privacy.

Free firewall is a full-featured professional firewall that protects against the threats of the
Internet. Control every program on your computer by permit or deny access to the Internet. Free
firewall notifies you when applications want to access the Internet in the background without your
knowledge.

[ Free Firewall ][12]

## HotkeyPro

Work faster. Increase productivity.

With HotkeyPro, you create hotkeys and keywords that allow you to automate various workflows and
actions. At the push of a button you can start programs, open folders or cathedral documents of any
kind, insert your own texts, simulate keystrokes and process scripts with which the range of
functions can be extended many times over..

[ HotkeyPro ][13]

## Cloudevo

Connect all your cloud storage together.

The software Cloudevo aggregates any number of cloud storage to a big united cloud. Cloudevo
combines all of the different cloud services to one large cloud. This united Cloud is then mounted
as a drive on your device. All files are encrypted securely on the Cloud drive.

[ Cloudevo ][14]

## Security breaks when firewall policy breaks.

Enterprises don’t lack cybersecurity tools. They lack control.

Policies are scattered across firewalls, clouds, and segmentation tools, creating blind spots,
drift, and compliance gaps that attackers exploit.

#### FireMon brings it back together.

## How we stop policy from undermining security:

[Firewall Policy Management from Ground to Cloud][Firewall Policy Management from Ground to Cloud]

### Firewall Policy Management from Ground to Cloud

FireMon serves as the system of record for network security policy. It normalizes and governs
firewall rules across on-prem and cloud environments, giving teams a single place to manage policy
for safer and controlled change.

security controls and demonstrates compliance to the **Product Security and Telecommunications
Infrastructure Act 2022.**

security. The scheme aligns with UK legislation and all of the 13 provisions in the **ETSI EN 303
645 standard**, extending beyond just the top three required for UK law.

vessels and is accessible to operators and vessels of all sizes from across the world.

mechanism to review and manage the cyber security risks within the sector via a network of Cyber

# **Welcome to IT Monteur an IT Infrastructure & Data Center Management Company**

### Secure IT Infrastructure, Cyber Security, AI & Software Development, Mobile Apps, ERP Solutions,
### and Web Hosting — Powered by Global Technology Partnerships

Information Technology now drives every business. Each organization depends on a connected IT
infrastructure — local networks, internet, systems, servers, cloud platforms, and business
applications working together seamlessly. Proper management and maintenance of these resources is
essential to keep operations smooth, fast, and reliable.

**Cyber Security is at the core of our expertise.** IT security is the most critical layer in any
infrastructure — every device, server, application, and data asset must be protected. Security
threats, ransomware, data breaches, and system failures can disrupt business and cause serious
financial loss if not handled proactively. At **IT Monteur**, we design and manage secure IT
environments with industry-leading security solutions and best practices.

We are proud to partner with **more than 12 leading global security and networking companies**,
including **Juniper**, **Cisco**, **Checkpoint**, **Palo Alto**, **Fortigate**, **Forcepoint**,
**Sophos**, **Watchguard**, **Barracuda**, **Sonicwall**, **Gajshield**, and **Quick Heal –
Seqrite** — enabling us to deliver proven, enterprise-grade protection for businesses of every size.

In today’s always-on business environment, downtime is not an option. Mission-critical applications
and your entire IT facility must stay available, secure, and performance-ready. Our technical
professionals bring more than a decade of experience in IT infrastructure, cyber security, and
software engineering.

We provide complete **IT Infrastructure Management and Security**, including Networking Solutions,
Internet Solutions, Email Solutions, Server Management, and Server Monitoring. Alongside this, we
deliver **AI Services**, **Software Development**, and **Mobile App Development** — building custom
web and mobile applications for Android and iOS using modern technologies such as **Node.js**,
**React**, and **Java**, backed by enterprise databases including **MySQL**, **MS SQL**, and
**Oracle**.

From requirement analysis and UI/UX design to development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support
— we help businesses digitize operations, automate workflows

Core Capabilities

## Enterprise Security Features Built In

Every [Netgate appliance][29] ships with pfSense® — the world's most trusted open-source firewall
platform.

#### Stateful Firewall

Deep packet inspection with stateful connection tracking. Block threats before they reach your
network perimeter.

#### VPN Gateway

IPsec, OpenVPN and WireGuard® support. Secure site-to-site and remote-access VPN for your workforce.

#### IDS / IPS

Snort and Suricata integration for real-time intrusion detection and prevention with auto-blocking
rules.

#### Content Filtering

Web content filtering with pfBlockerNG — block ads, trackers, malicious domains and inappropriate
content.

#### Traffic Shaping / QoS

HFSC and PRIQ traffic shaping. Prioritise voice, video and critical business applications
automatically.

#### Multi-WAN & Failover

Load balance across multiple ISP links and automatic failover — ensuring zero downtime for your
business.

#### VLAN Segmentation

Isolate networks with 802.1Q VLAN support. Separate IoT, guest, employee and PCI DSS zones
effortlessly.

#### Monitoring & Reporting

Real-time dashboards, bandwidth graphs, traffic analysis and syslog export to your SIEM platform.

#### High Availability

CARP-based HA clustering with automatic state sync. Deploy active-passive pairs for mission-critical
uptime.

# Private Proxy Guide – VPN, Proxy & Online Privacy Guides


# Private Proxy Guide

Private Proxy Guide provides independent guides and reviews focused on VPN services, proxy
solutions, and online privacy tools.

Our goal is to explain how VPNs and proxy services work in real-world scenarios, how to use them on
different devices and apps, and how to choose the right solution based on security, performance, and
access needs.

All guides are written with a practical focus, combining technical explanations with step-by-step
instructions to help you understand and use privacy tools more effectively.

VPN & device setups
Proxy & scraping use cases
Privacy & security fundamentals
Hands-on testing
Clear, practical guidance

**Editorial approach:** clarity, transparency, and usability rather than generic rankings or
marketing claims.

## On Private Proxy Guide, you’ll find

VPN guides for devices, apps, streaming services, and online platforms

Explanations of VPN protocols, encryption, and security features

Proxy guides covering residential, datacenter, and scraping use cases

Practical tutorials showing how to set up and use privacy tools correctly

We focus on **clarity**, **transparency**, and **usability** rather than generic rankings or
marketing claims.

## How we cover VPNs & privacy

Our VPN and privacy content covers a wide range of use cases, including mobile devices, desktop
systems, routers, gaming platforms, and popular online services.

Instead of focusing only on “best” lists, we explain why certain features matter, how performance is
affected in different situations, and what to consider before choosing a VPN or proxy service.

### Proxy technology guides

In addition to VPNs, we publish detailed guides about proxy technologies and network privacy. These
articles explain how different proxy types work, when they are useful, and how they compare to VPN
solutions for tasks such as automation, scraping, and traffic routing.

### Independent methodology

Our guides are created independently and are based on hands-on testing, technical analysis, and
real-world usage scenarios. We aim to provide balanced information that helps readers understand
both the advantages and limitations of different tools, without relying on exaggerated claims or
unnecessary complexity.

## Who this site is for

Private Proxy Guide is designed to help users navigate online privacy with confidence, whether they
are beginners or more advanced users.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

# The First and Only Solution for Multi-Vendor Agentic Network Security

The network is entering the agentic era. As AI drives machine-speed change across enterprise
environments, security teams can no longer rely on manual reviews and point-in-time checks.

Tufin gives teams a trusted, unified way to understand connectivity, prove posture continuously, and
control change across complex multi-vendor networks.

[Request a Demo][142]

### Find out why thousands of customers trust Tufin

## The Unified Control Plane for the Agentic Era

As agents initiate, validate, and execute more infrastructure change, decisions that affect network
connectivity happen faster than security teams can review manually. Security teams need more than
visibility. They need a trusted way to understand what is actually reachable, validate policy
intent, and govern change across the enterprise.

Tufin provides that control through a unified control plane built for complex multi-vendor networks.

## One Control Plane. Total Network Control.

Tufin manages fragmented tools with a unified control plane that delivers centralized visibility,
automated change control, and continuous compliance across your entire hybrid network.

[

### Unified Visibility Across Hybrid Environments

Delivers the most accurate network topology across firewalls, routers, SASE, and cloud platforms
like AWS, Azure, and GCP—unifying visibility and control across hybrid environments.

][144]
[

### Prevents Misconfigurations and Policy Drift

Continuously monitor firewalls, cloud, SASE, and microsegmentation environments to ensure alignment
and enforcement of security policies, preventing lateral movement paths before attackers can exploit
them.

See it in action
][145]
[

### Simplifies and Optimizes Security Policy Management

Reduces policy complexity by analyzing and cleaning up redundant, risky, and outdated rules, while
automatically enforcing least-privilege access to strengthen your overall security posture.

See it in action
][146]
[

### Maintains Continuous Compliance and Audit Readiness

Reduces audit effort and minimizes regulatory risk by continuously assessing policies against
internal standards and external frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOX, DORA, and NIST.

See it in action
][147]

## A Control Plane for Your Entire Network Security Ecosystem

Tufin integrates seamlessly with the technologies powering your hybrid network—from firewalls to
cloud, SASE, microsegmentation, and beyond.

### Multi-Vendor Firewalls

Centralized visibility and unified policy enforcement across traditional and hybrid mesh
architectures, including Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, Fortinet, and more.

The control plane streamlines management, eliminates configuration silos, and ensures consistent,
least-privilege policies across on-premises and cloud networks—helping security teams operate faster
and reduce risk at scale.

# BIBEK JYOTI ROY

Cybersecurity Expert & Serial Entrepreneur

On a mission to build a secure digital world, empowering individuals and businesses against the
ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats.

## / ABOUT ME

Bibek Jyoti Roy is an Indian cybersecurity expert and entrepreneur. He has made significant
contributions in the fields of programming, bug bounty, penetration testing, and Open Source
Intelligence (OSINT). He has helped many companies, such as IND Money and Phind, identify security
vulnerabilities in their systems. In 2021, he founded Psylinks Security, a company dedicated to
providing advanced cybersecurity solutions, and has since expanded into education, blockchain, open
research, and health & wellness sectors with multiple ventures aimed at creating positive societal
impact.

### Personal

Born: 23 September 2002 (age 22)

Location: Guwahati, Assam, India

Parents: Bijan Roy & Juthika Roy

### Education

Arya Vidyapeeth College

Girijananda Choudhury Institute of Management and Technology, Guwahati

### Organizations Founded

Psylinks Security (2021)

Blockvizion (2023)

Tutoring Point (2024)

Codesity (2025)

Cafel (2025)

### Skills & Expertise

Programming Bug Hunting Penetration Testing OSINT

### Books Written

Play, Click and Learn (2024)

### / CONNECT

[Facebook][19]

## / VENTURES

### Psylinks Security

Founded: 2021

An enterprise tech company dedicated to protecting businesses and individuals from cyber threats
through advanced threat detection, data protection, and customized security strategies.

### Blockvizion

Founded: 2023

A forward-thinking venture exploring the applications of blockchain technology to enhance data
security, transparency, and create decentralized solutions for modern digital challenges.

### Tutoring Point

Founded: 2024

An education service startup dedicated to providing high-quality, personalized learning experiences.
Tutoring Point connects students with dedicated educators for tailored home tutoring and academic
support.

### Codesity

Founded: 2025

An independent open research company operating as a fully private, not-for-profit entity. Conducts
rigorous research and development across technology, medicine, food science, and education systems.
All findings and innovations are made freely accessible to society, advancing human knowledge and
wellbeing without commercial constraints or external influence.

### Cafel

Founded: 2025

Guwahati's premier healthy dining destination in Jyotikuchi, offering scientifically-designed meals
that heal and nourish. Features traditional Indian and authentic Assamese cuisine made with 100%
organic, farm-fresh ingredients—no preservatives, chemicals, or refined oils. Every dish is cooked
fresh to order for genuine well-being.

## / VISION

"My vision extends beyond simply reacting to threats. I believe in proactive, intelligent security
that anticipates and neutralizes risks before they can cause harm. We are moving towards a future
where cybersecurity is not a barrier, but an enabler of innovation and trust."

"Through my ventures, we are committed to continuous research and development, staying ahead of the
curve and building a resilient digital infrastructure for the next generation of technology. From
securing digital assets to advancing open scientific research and nourishing physical health, each
venture serves a purpose in creating a better, more equitable tomorrow where knowledge and wellbeing
are accessible to all."

## / CONTACT US

We welcome your feedback, inquiries, and comments. Please feel free to reach out.

CSSI

A leader in engineered asset protection using composite material technology.

# Advanced Fire, Ballistic & Impact Protection SolutionsEngineered Ceramic Composite Panels Designed
# to Protect Critical Assets

CSSI delivers engineered protection solutions backed by proven research and unmatched material
performance. We combine proven technical expertise with advanced ceramic composites that offer
exceptional [fire][13] and [ballistic resistance][14], structural integrity, and long-term
durability, even in the most demanding environments.

[Our clients][15] include architectural and engineering firms, utility contractors, public and
private utilities, defense contractors, data management companies, and government agencies. We work
closely with our customers to develop tailored composite solutions to protect their critical,
sensitive, and valuable assets.

## Why Choose CSSI?

### Customizable Sizes and Designs
* Modular lightweight panels (320 lb.) for easy handling and installation.
* A standard wall (35 feet L x 30 feet H) can be installed in one day.
* Short manufacturing time, 4–6 weeks, and 3–4 months for large orders.
* Permanent or deployable wall systems available.
* Designed and manufactured in the USA.

### Reduction in Time, Labor and Costs
* Material costs are typically in line with precast concrete options.
* Panels are installed quickly, saving time and reducing labor costs.
* Freight and shipping costs are lower than those for concrete wall systems.

### Environmental Responsible Panels
* Panels are manufactured using sustainable technology.
* Manufacturing and shipping related CO₂ emissions are reduced when compared to concrete wall
  systems.

## Ceramic Composite Panel Benefits
* Firewall panels are formed to include air pockets for superior thermal insulation and fire
  resistance.
* Internal air pockets of ballistic panels are filled with sand or pea gravel to absorb and
  dissipate energy from gunshots and ballistic projectiles.
* Steel columns, casings, and nuts are protected using composite materials.
* Designed to minimize load-bearing impact at the base of the wall.
* Panels exceed government and private industry tests for strength and impact.
* No maintenance needed.
* Earthquake proof.
* Walls can be installed in extreme cold climates and withstand severe weather and harsh
  environmental conditions.

## Protecting Critical Infrastructure from the Ground Up

Let’s get started on a composite wall solution for you today.

## Security breaks when firewall policy breaks.

Enterprises don’t lack cybersecurity tools. They lack control.

Policies are scattered across firewalls, clouds, and segmentation tools, creating blind spots,
drift, and compliance gaps that attackers exploit.

#### FireMon brings it back together.

# OWASP
# Modsecurity Project

[Rules protecting a safe]

## Open Source Web Application Firewall

[ModSecurity][14] is an open source, cross-platform web application firewall (WAF) module. Known as
the “Swiss Army Knife” of WAFs, it enables web application defenders to gain visibility into HTTP(S)
traffic and provides a power rules language and API to implement advanced protections.

[Get latest v2: 2.9.12][15] [Get latest v3: 3.0.14][16]

## The most widespread open source WAF

Used by businesses, government organizations, internet service providers, and commercial WAF vendors
alike on millions of domains all over the world. The engine, coupled with OWASP CRS - the dominant
WAF rule set, undeniably raises the level of protection against HTTP attacks to a higher level.

[Become a part of it!][17]

## ModSecurity under OWASP's custodianship

OWASP® Foundation, the leading open community dedicated to application security, is already
responsible for the Core Rule Set, the dominant WAF rule set on the market. By joining the
ModSecurity WAF to their repertoire, OWASP can now steer ModSecurity’s development with a holistic
view, fostering even tighter integration between the core rule set and the underlying framework.
[Rules protecting a safe]

### Getting Started

## Usage scenarios
* Real-time application security monitoring and access control
* Full HTTP traffic logging
* Continuous passive security assessment
* Web application hardening

[Download][18]

## Principles
* Flexibility
* Passiveness
* Predictability
* Quality over quantity

[Getting Started][19]

## Community

👋 Be part of a vibrant and welcoming community.

🗺️ Join us on Slack for discussions, see GitHub for our projects, or follow us on Twitter.

🤙 We are always looking for new contributors and developers.

[Community][20]

# Private Proxy Guide

Private Proxy Guide provides independent guides and reviews focused on VPN services, proxy
solutions, and online privacy tools.

Our goal is to explain how VPNs and proxy services work in real-world scenarios, how to use them on
different devices and apps, and how to choose the right solution based on security, performance, and
access needs.

All guides are written with a practical focus, combining technical explanations with step-by-step
instructions to help you understand and use privacy tools more effectively.

**Editorial approach:** clarity, transparency, and usability rather than generic rankings or
marketing claims.

## On Private Proxy Guide, you’ll find

VPN guides for devices, apps, streaming services, and online platforms

Explanations of VPN protocols, encryption, and security features

Proxy guides covering residential, datacenter, and scraping use cases

Practical tutorials showing how to set up and use privacy tools correctly

We focus on **clarity**, **transparency**, and **usability** rather than generic rankings or
marketing claims.

## How we cover VPNs & privacy

Our VPN and privacy content covers a wide range of use cases, including mobile devices, desktop
systems, routers, gaming platforms, and popular online services.

Instead of focusing only on “best” lists, we explain why certain features matter, how performance is
affected in different situations, and what to consider before choosing a VPN or proxy service.

### Proxy technology guides

In addition to VPNs, we publish detailed guides about proxy technologies and network privacy. These
articles explain how different proxy types work, when they are useful, and how they compare to VPN
solutions for tasks such as automation, scraping, and traffic routing.

### Independent methodology

Our guides are created independently and are based on hands-on testing, technical analysis, and
real-world usage scenarios. We aim to provide balanced information that helps readers understand
both the advantages and limitations of different tools, without relying on exaggerated claims or
unnecessary complexity.

## Who this site is for

Private Proxy Guide is designed to help users navigate online privacy with confidence, whether they
are beginners or more advanced users.
